title: Separate facts from staffing policy
when: Looking up a model or proposing a level change
need: Catalog research holds sourced model facts, efforts, successors and effective dates; levels hold ordered model/min_effort thresholds. Catalog updates do not silently change approved preferences. Unknown models or unpublished effort establish no level: item/task claims and work launches refuse session_below_intern; refresh catalog/native facts or select a supported model and effort before retrying. Known older models without explicit rows demote one class at the same effort; bottom-class predecessors and single-class Grok refuse.
surface: Yoke Help -> Models skill; docs sidebar -> CLI/config -> model reference and execution levels.
review: Admission and predecessor behavior observed in the shipped routing guide and source; live 18-row definition reread 2026-10-13.
